Timeline Builder

Add a second (or more) track to compare related timelines stacked on the same year axis — e.g. a country's history vs. world history.

Broad periods like "Renaissance" shown as a shaded band behind the events, distinct from a single event's own range bar.

Events sharing a category are colored the same on the timeline, with a legend below it.

Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded, including any photos you attach. Photos are downscaled before saving.
